name: Dearest...
source:
If you had to choose between two precious things, which would you select?
Your beloved wife or your beloved daughters?
In a short period of one week, you have to interact with your memories of them and make a choice. Which will you give up and which will you keep? Remember not to regret the choice you have made... 

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30758]Freem![/url]]
